title: Fall colors
hint: Photograph a tree with red, orange or yellow leaves.
check: a tree or branch with red, orange or yellow autumn leaves

title: Seed hunter
hint: Find acorns, seeds, cones or berries from a tree.
check: tree seeds, acorns, pine cones, seed pods or berries

title: Leaf drop
hint: Catch fallen leaves on the ground under a tree.

title: Bark detective
hint: Get a close-up of a tree's bark.

title: Tree hugger
hint: Take a photo of you (or a friend) next to a campus tree.
check: a person standing next to, touching or hugging a tree

title: Who lives here?
hint: Spot a squirrel, bird or bug on or near a tree.
check: a squirrel, bird, insect or other animal on or near a tree

title: First buds
hint: Find a tree with new buds or tiny leaves.
check: a tree branch with new buds or small new leaves

title: Blossom spotter
check: a tree with flowers or blossoms

title: Shade finder
hint: Show the cool shade under a big tree.
check: the shadow or shade under a tree's canopy

title: Winter tree
hint: Photograph a bare or snowy tree.
check: a bare or snow-covered tree in winter
